description: This file contains functions for processing and translating documentation files with frontmatter, including parsing, formatting, applying translations, and handling file paths.

methods.name: processFileDoc
methods.description: Reads a file, processes frontmatter and body, translates content, updates frontmatter, and saves translated documentation.

methods.name: formatTaggedDocument
methods.description: Formats frontmatter and body into a tagged document string.

methods.name: parseTaggedDocument
methods.description: Parses a tagged document string into frontmatter and body components.

methods.name: trimTagNewlines
methods.description: Removes leading and trailing newlines from the input string.

methods.name: buildFrontmatterTemplate
methods.description: Builds frontmatter template lines and markers based on input data.

methods.name: markerPair
methods.description: Generates start and end marker strings for a given field and index.

methods.name: applyFrontmatterTranslations
methods.description: Updates the frontmatter data with translated values based on markers.

methods.name: extractMarkerValue
methods.description: Extracts the value between specified start and end markers in the text.

methods.name: setReadWhenValue
methods.description: Sets the value at a specified index in the 'read_when' array.

methods.name: shouldSkipDoc
methods.description: Determines whether to skip processing a document based on existing hash comparison.

methods.name: extractSourceHash
methods.description: Extracts the source hash from frontmatter data.

methods.name: resolveDocsPath
methods.description: Resolves absolute and relative paths, ensuring the file is within the docs root.
